name: Burning Wood
title: Burning Wood
summary: The south-west valley of the Graveyard (66.5S 44.8W): 26 m dead antler-branched trees, deer skeletons, tombstones, portal pillars and purple candlesticks around a grass-roofed bunker on a burnt volcanic floor (z 4-8); the Corrupted Pyre Oak and Lord Hendrel appear here.

site.name: Burning Wood
site.notes: Derived teleport in the wood 24 m east of the acpedia point, 6.5 m from the nearest dead tree.

routeNote: Moved from candeth-keep -> qalabar to wai-jhou -> candeth-keep so the three Graveyard-valley POIs (Knathtead Excavation, Burning Wood, Arcanum Lookout, all within 800 m) cut together; insert cost 2.07 km vs 1.90 km for the given slot (teleport hops, so the extra 0.17 km is free on the shoot).

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down from 32 m over the Burning Wood and rise to 72 m, turning 25 degrees, as the dead antler trees, bunker and tombstones shrink into a pattern; 10 m above the tallest crown at the start.
shots.notes: God's-eye rise from 32 m to 72 m over the Burning Wood, turning 25 deg: the dead antler-branched trees, the grass-roofed bunker, tombstones and purple candlesticks shrink into a pattern on the burnt floor.
